_doc: Who is where (the Ring 1 roster, people spec §21.1; kind: full, light or role, people spec §3.1) in the survivors' camp (design/ruins/content.md §1). schedule: a spot (data/world/map.json spots) for each time of day, or "" for off the map. overrides: the first that holds wins: days ("4", "1-7", "2,3"), times (comma list or any), when (a story condition), spot, and seek: walk up to the wizard and start talking (once a loop). from_day: not in the camp before that day. barks: lines said over the head now and then, the first few that hold are picked at random; each can have days, times and when. figure: the look in data/visual.json figures. reach: how close you must be to talk (sim px). Nobody follows you into the ruin.

barks.text: Lamp oil's the only thing that didn't burn.
Somebody has to light them. Might as well be me.
One more, then the next.
Stay in the light, College. They come up at night.
Bread for the camp. Such as it is.
Flour and ash. Flour and ash.
Don't stand by the cellar door. Please.
Anything you need, I'll find it. Anything.
Someone should go down there. Someone brave.
Nobody goes past the gate.
Count your people. Then count them again.
Lamps lit before dark, or nobody sleeps.
Pies! Well. Pie.
Hot, at least. It's hot.
Wuff.
(sniffs at your boots)
Forty pockets and every one of them for sale.
Guild work. Built to last, priced to match.
Mind the rails. They bite.
Bowl. Spoon. Sit. Eat.
Soup's on. Thin, but on.
Has anyone seen my Tam?
Want some water? I carry the water.
I nearly lit a Kindle yesterday. Nearly.
Mum says inside before the lamps.
Sit, if you like. The fire doesn't ask questions.
Say their names. It helps. It does.
Again. Cleaner. Again.
Cass. Don't draw on that, it's someone's.
Oh. You.
Hold still. No, you moved. Hold still.
Silas says I laugh too loud. Silas is wrong.
The lamps look like little moons from up here.
(watches you from a safe distance)
(trails after the lamplighter)
Letters, parcels, bad news. Same rate.
Don't touch the satchel. Guild seal.
(chewing) Mm. Don't ask what it is.
Good day, wizard. Keep your hands where I can see them, if you'd be so kind.
The Oath keeps the road. For now.
(says nothing, and watches you go by)
Move along.
Sit. Don't move. That's an order and a diagnosis.
Clean water. Clean linen. Prayers optional.
Your beer is a crime against stone.
West. The Holds are always west.
(plays the second of his four songs)
Four songs. All of them sad. Pick one.

_crowd_doc: Survivors who wander the market and the square by day: how many at each time of day, and where they wander.

barks: Have you seen my brother? Tall, a blue coat?
The College did this. The College and its Orrery.
The light. Did you see the light?
Twenty-some days to the Eclipse. Will it happen again?
Things came up out of the cellars last night.
They say the Provost walked into it.

_reactions_doc: How people answer magic cast near them (OW2, interactions.md §5): within flinch_r sim px of a spell they step back flinch_step and say a flinch line (a person's own "flinch" list if they have one), then not again for flinch_cool seconds. Fire in the College ruins brings the watch captain's line if the captain can see you (bark_range), at most every scold_cool seconds. Lighting a lamp on Mira's lane before she does brings mira_thanks if she's near, and a thank-you scene when you next talk to her.

reactions.mira_thanks: My lane's lit? That was you, College. Thank you.
reactions.captain_fire: Put that out! Fire's what did all this.

_v2_doc: Schedules v2 (N-7.2.1, people spec §3.2): a person's rows, the first that holds wins: days and moons ("4", "1-7", "2,3"), weekdays (spheres), seasons, slot (times or any), weather (kinds), if (a story condition); map (camp unless given) and at (a spot there, "" off the map, or "away", gone from the region; an away row may name its rumour); doing (busy doings answer a talk with busy_line unless the person has something new to say); seek. cover: where a person goes in the weathers of cover_in when their row has no weather of its own. memories_max: the deeds a person remembers of you in a life (story effect remember).
